name: @n1h/sweetview-webview-bun
description: Bun bindings for webview, a tiny library for creating web-based desktop GUIs. A fork of webview-bun whose shipped library adds webview_set_asset, webview_set_background_color, a request handler with a second cross-origin origin (webview_set_request_handler, webview_complete_request), webview_set_allow_external_drop and system-wide mouse and keyboard hooks (webview_mouse_hook_install, webview_keyboard_hook_install) with modifier keys on every event.
author: Mrowr Purr
